title: Overwatch Student Series Fall 2026
body:
We are going to be running an Overwatch 3v3 Lockout Elimination tournament! You may signup as a premade team or as a free agent!

Schedule (subject to change):
Friday, September 25th - Grouping Stage  @ 7pm
Saturday, September 26th - Beginning of Double Elimination @ 7pm
Sunday, September 27th - Semi-finals and Finals @ 7pm
imageAlt: Graphic for the Esports at UCF Overwatch student series. taking place Sept 25-27th. Game mode 3v3 lockout.
